name: Perth to Port Augusta — schematic east–west corridor
coordinate_basis: Manually rounded approximate locality centres for a demonstration. Not surveyed track, terminal or station coordinates. Route references establish locality sequence, not coordinate accuracy.
limitations: Approximate place coordinates joined by schematic segments; not surveyed rail alignment.
Distance is a geographic screening estimate, not track distance, road access or freight routing.
Inside the buffer does not establish monitoring coverage, a mine connection or rail operating status.
The 50 km buffer is an illustrative screening choice, not an operational safety boundary.
